interpretation: Exact balance removes underdetermined experts and improves the oracle, but even per-token oracle expert selection cannot clear the local gate. The remaining blocker is piecewise-linear coefficient-map capacity rather than support imbalance or routing alone.
decision: Close sparse piecewise-linear residual mapping. Authorize one no-model feasibility audit for a dense rank-768 nonlinear coefficient host with hidden width 384, subject to unchanged active-compute, memory, and zero-source-block constraints.
claim_boundary: Negative layer-1 sparse mapping evidence only; no artifact, certificate, or superiority claim.
